Keiarna Stewart (born November 28, 1987) is an American television personality and entrepreneur. She is known for her role as a cast member on reality television series The Real Housewives of Potomac, joining as a friend of the cast in Season 8 and becoming a full-time cast member in Season 9. Stewart is also the founder of K. Stewart Beauty & Wellness, a MedSpa in Baltimore’s Harbor East.
Career
Stewart began her career in the beauty industry by opening a hair salon in Baltimore, Maryland. She later expanded her business founding K. Stewart Beauty & Wellness, a MedSpa located in Harbor East, Baltimore.
Television career
Stewart joined The Real Housewives of Potomac as a friend of the housewives in its eighth season, and later in the ninth season, she was upgraded to a full-time cast member. On the show, Stewart is known for sharing her personal journey, including her relationship with her boyfriend, Gregory, and her role as a business owner.
Philanthropy
Stewart has worked with women empowerment organizations such as Black Girls Vote, Color Vision, and The Well.
Personal life
Keiarna Stewart was born and raised in Baltimore, Maryland, She is in a relationship with her boyfriend, Gregory, and resides in Maryland.
